container-instances-spot-interruptible.title: Spot containers fit work that can be interrupted
container-instances-spot-interruptible.body: This workload can be stopped and restarted, but the containers are priced as regular-priority. Microsoft says Spot containers cost up to 70% less than regular-priority containers, with the trade-off that Azure can evict them at any time. Compare the Spot option.

citation.quote: up to a 70% discount compared to regular-priority ACI containers

container-instances-spot-production.title: Spot containers are not recommended for production
container-instances-spot-production.body: This production workload runs on Spot containers. Microsoft describes Spot containers as a preview that is not recommended for production scenarios, and Azure can evict them at any time. Use standard containers for production unless the customer accepts that.

citation.quote: Spot containers with Azure Container Instances is in preview and is not recommended for production scenarios.

container-instances-savings-plan-steady.title: Compare an Azure savings plan for steady container use
container-instances-savings-plan-steady.body: These containers are priced pay as you go and are expected to run steadily for a year or longer. Microsoft offers a compute savings plan that discounts select compute services, including Container Instances, for a fixed hourly commitment of 1 or 3 years. Compare the savings-plan price in this estimate.

citation.quote: Save money across select compute services globally by committing to spend a fixed hourly amount for 1 or 3 years
